nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set in Owned constructor from msg.sender.
Pending owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer.
Token symbol string set in the _Token constructor to 'Alaska'.
Token name string set in the _Token constructor to 'Alaska Fan Token'.
Total token supply state variable assigned from TOKEN_SUPPLY_TOTAL.
Mapping of holder address to token balance; central accounting storage.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to remaining allowance.
Constant total supply constant computed at compile time from supplyNumber, powNumber and decimals.
SafeMath helper performing a + b with overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath helper performing a - b with underflow require(b <= a).
SafeMath helper performing a * b with overflow require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath helper performing a / b with require(b > 0).
_Token constructor: sets symbol, name, _totalSupply, credits balances[msg.sender] and emits Transfer from address(0).
ERC20 totalSupply view returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
ERC20 balanceOf view returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer: safeSub from sender balance and safeAdd to recipient balance.
Airdrop-style batch transfer looping over receiver/amount arrays with a uint8 counter cast.
ERC20 approve writing allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
ERC20 transferFrom decreasing balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], increasing balances[to].
ERC20 allowance view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract before returning.
Payable fallback function that reverts all plain ether transfers.
Owner-only rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 token address.
Burns tokens by directly using unchecked -= and += operators on the balances mapping.
Owner-only function that stages newOwner for the two-step ownership transfer.
Completes ownership transfer after verifying msg.sender == newOwner.
Caller-controlled address used for balance debits, allowance ownership, ownership checks and supply assignment.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) with attacker-influenced spender.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-supplied contract address.
Unchecked subtraction balances[msg.sender] -= _value inside burn.
Unchecked addition balances[0x0] += _value inside burn, inflating the zero-address balance used by totalSupply.
uint8 truncation cnt = (uint8)(cnt) plus uint8 loop counter in batchTransfer, a lossy arithmetic conversion.
